name: Chris Thompson
biography: Chris is Red Team Operations Lead at IBM X-Force Red. He has extensive experience performing penetration testing and red teaming for clients in a wide variety of industries. He's led red teaming operations against defense contractors and some of North America's largest banks. He's on the board for CREST USA (crest-approved.org), working to help mature the pentesting industry. Chris also teaches Network & Mobile Pentesting at one of Canada's largest technical schools. Hacking his way through life, Chris likes to pretend he's a good drone pilot, lock picker, and mountain biker. Twitter: @retBandit
